supplier_name.description: Legal name of the company that ISSUED the invoice (the seller). Never the customer.

supplier_vat.description: The seller's VAT number exactly as printed, without spaces. Empty string if absent.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number exactly as printed. Empty string if absent.

invoice_date.description: Invoice date as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty string if absent.

due_date.description: Payment due date as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty string if absent.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR, GBP, USD.

po_number.description: The customer's purchase order reference (bon de commande, votre commande, PO number). Empty string if there is none.

lines.description: One entry per invoice line, in the order printed.

sku.description: Product code / reference exactly as printed. Empty string if absent.

unit_price.description: Unit price excluding VAT, as printed.

line_total.description: Line amount excluding VAT, as printed.

total_ht.description: Total excluding VAT (Total HT / Subtotal), as printed.

total_vat.description: VAT amount (TVA), as printed. 0 for reverse charge or zero-rated.

total_ttc.description: Total to pay including VAT (Total TTC / Net à payer / Amount due), as printed.
